title: Google Cloud Fundamentals: Core Infrastructure
overview: The Google Cloud Fundamentals: Core Infrastructure course is designed to provide a foundational understanding of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and solutions. This course covers core GCP infrastructure components, including compute, storage, and networking, and prepares participants for further specialization in Google Cloud technologies.
audience: Individuals new to Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and cloud computing.
IT professionals and system administrators looking to understand GCP infrastructure.
Developers and data engineers interested in GCP services and solutions.
Anyone preparing to build foundational knowledge of Google Cloud Platform.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: Detailed explanations of GCP core infrastructure services and components.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises for working with GCP services and tools.
Case Studies: Real-world examples to understand GCP solutions and use cases.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore GCP infrastructure challenges and solutions.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for further specialization.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a foundational understanding of Google Cloud Platform services and infrastructure.
To introduce participants to core GCP services, including compute, storage, and networking.
To prepare learners for further specialization in Google Cloud technologies.
To familiarize participants with GCP deployment, management, and security best practices.
